scope: Screen a publicly viewable Scribd copy titled as the 2023 Labac-Alemang River Watershed characterization and vulnerability assessment. Determine whether its biological-results section contains site-resolved fish evidence and whether any fishery prose can safely be assigned to the Labac study area. The copy is not treated as an authenticated official publication.

method.accessedItem: Public Scribd item 967301326, titled Watershed Characterization and Vulnerability Assessment of Labac-Alemang River Watershed, 2023; uploaded by cutolentino. The Scribd page states 'All Rights Reserved'.
reviewedSections: Report title and discussion of the 2015 baseline and 2023 watershed update
Biological resources, flora and fauna assessment sections
Maragondon municipal-profile water and fishery text
searches: Exact 2023 report title scoped to government and CvSU domains
Labac-Alemang and watershed assessment exact-title searches
Fish, fishes, aquatic fauna, fish species and ichthyofauna within the indexed report text
method.localRetention: The online text view was inspected only. No PDF, map, table, photo, or report text was downloaded or retained; no login or access-control workaround was used.

findings: The Scribd copy describes itself as a 2023 update to watershed characterization work first prepared in 2015 and refers to a 2021 FMB-smoothed watershed boundary. These are statements in an unauthenticated third-party copy, not independently verified source metadata or a geometry license.

The reviewed biological-results section describes six-site flora quadrats and fauna work on arthropods and birds. The water-quality/river-profile sites are environmental sampling context; the indexed report text did not expose a fish-specific sampling method, fish-by-site table, fish vouchers, or capture dates.

A separate Maragondon municipal-profile passage lists mackerel, nemipterids, grouper, squid, tuna and hasa-hasa, then labels them 'freshwater fishes.' It is not presented as the Labac watershed field survey or assigned to the six water-quality sites. The labels include a non-fish group and a marine/freshwater context mismatch, so this passage is excluded from Labac species evidence.
Fishpond and fish-cage production figures elsewhere in the report are aquaculture/economic context, not wild occurrence or a river survey.

The public item is a user-uploaded copy and explicitly states 'All Rights Reserved'. A bounded official-domain search surfaced the earlier 2015 abstract but did not verify an official distribution of this 2023 full report or item-specific reuse permission.

rightsReview.assessment: The Scribd page declares all rights reserved, but the uploader's authority and the underlying report's publisher/reuse terms are not established. Do not redistribute the report, tables, maps, photographs, or extracted datasets.
rightsReview.disposition: Keep only a concise bibliographic and source-scope note in the research ledger. Do not use the copy as an app source or reproduce its figures or map geometry.

decision.disposition: Register this third-party copy as a research-only scope and retrieval lead. Exclude the Maragondon fishery paragraph from Labac fish evidence; continue to treat the 2015 official abstract and the 2023 AIIB EIA as separate sources with their own limitations.

limitations: Scribd's indexed text can contain OCR or table-layout errors; the original PDF pages and maps were not visually reviewed or retained.
The copy's official publisher, issuing unit, final approval, report version, file hash, dataset supplement, and item-specific data license were not verified.
Failure to find a fish survey in the reviewed text sections does not prove that no fish work exists in an unreviewed annex or underlying source.
No current fish presence, absence, abundance, habitat preference, catchability, safety, access, or fishing-rule claim is established.
nextActions: Do not use the Scribd copy to add species, occurrences, waterbody geometry, or legal/safety advice.

If an authenticated official 2023 report or annex becomes available, check its source provenance, fish-specific methods and site table, collection dates, identifications/vouchers, and reuse terms before extracting anything.
Continue the separate search for independently reusable, site-resolved fish sources for CALABARZON inland waters.

sources.supports: Third-party copy title, uploader, displayed all-rights-reserved notice, and the text sections summarized in this review.
Officially hosted 2015 abstract for the earlier Labac-Alemang watershed assessment; it identifies the separate baseline and is not the 2023 report.
